name: Fortress Line: Tactical Command
summary:
Fortress Line: Tactical Command is a single-player VR/MR strategy game that combines overhead battlefield command with direct soldier combat.
From above, use hand tracking to select units, deploy soldiers, and issue movement orders as enemy waves approach. To join the fight, select a soldier and take control from their perspective. Fight on the ground, move through the battlefield, and defend the line firsthand.
Switch between strategic command and direct combat as the situation changes.
Begin with the Tuto
